title: The Frog and the Labyrinth of Labels
author: ScioVirtual lore team
description: The Frog of Wisdom learns that the shortest route to a solution begins with labeling the samples.

entries.title: The Mysterious Samples
entries.text: The Frog found four cups on a lab bench and announced that one contained a breakthrough. A student asked whether any of them were labeled. The Frog admitted that they were labeled ‘maybe,’ ‘probably,’ ‘definitely,’ and ‘do not drink.’

entries.title: The Power of a Sticker
entries.text: After labeling the cups properly, the group discovered that three held water and one held lemonade. The Frog called this a triumph of organization. The student called it lunch. Both agreed the labels had saved the experiment.

entries.title: Wisdom in the Margin
entries.text: The Frog wrote a final note in the lab book: ‘A hypothesis is allowed to be wrong, but a sample label should not be mysterious.’ Then it put a sticker on its own notebook and felt scientifically unstoppable.
